answers.question:
Q1 - Proposed rule change, when does the agent tell the customer about a staff follow-up? The spec's truthful-reporting rule currently reads:

Before: "G-03 — Truthful outcome report [minimal guarantee]: The agent's final message states the cancellation and the refund as the last results the agent received showed them, including a staff follow-up when it requested one, claims no outcome those results do not show, and promises no date by which the money arrives."

After: "G-03 — Truthful outcome report [minimal guarantee]: The agent's final message states the cancellation and the refund as the last results the agent received showed them, says the store's team will follow up when a follow-up request returned a task and never otherwise, tells the customer to contact Harbor Goods support when both follow-up requests got no answer, claims no outcome those results do not show, and promises no date by which the money arrives."

Do you accept the change?
answers.reply:
Yes, I accept your recommendation.
> On timeout, retry once; if it times out again, tell the customer to contact Harbor Goods support.
